newsitem.title: USA: PG&E restarts Diablo Canyon 2 nuclear unit.
newsitem.headline: PG&E restarts Diablo Canyon 2 nuclear unit.

text.p: PG&E Corp's Diablo Canyon 2 nuclear power plant was operating at 50 percent of its rated 1,073 megawatt capacity early Monday following restart over the weekend, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The plant is currently going through restart testing, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The plant, in Avila Beach on the central California coast, was manually shut down July 2 because of problems with its feedwater syatem.
Diablo Canyon 1, the adjoining 1,083 MW unit, was operating at full power, the NRC said.
